checked_claims.note: The primitive quotient formula is not established by the submitted argument. The pullback of the psi class to the fibre power is not Kunneth-homogeneous: fibre restriction detects its slot-2 component but does not eliminate its slot-1 component. The required projector, Morita vanishing, or downward-induction argument is absent. Deligne supplies only a lowest-weight surjection from the proper fibre power, not the asserted kernel identification or traceless Schur-Weyl quotient. Degeneration likewise supplies an associated graded, not the written direct-sum decomposition of mixed Hodge structures.

The numerical local-coefficient vcd calculation H^20(M_6;V_lambda)=0 is sound, but it is applied only after the failed primitive-quotient identification. At degree 26, vcd kills Kunneth slots of total fibre degree at most 6; slots of total fibre degree at least 7 have base degree at most 19 and are not killed. The attempt never proves that these surviving slots, each containing a slot of degree 2, lie in the psi image.

The constant-coefficient vcd computation vcd(PMod_{6,5})=25 gives H^26(M_{6,5};Q)=0 and hence the relevant forgetful pullback contribution vanishes. This does not control the unaccounted local-system Kunneth slots.

The CKgP and tautological-Chow input applies at the boundary case n=5=c(6). It makes W_24 H^24(M_{6,5};Q) algebraic and Tate of type Q(-12), so its products with psi classes have type Q(-13). It does not establish that these products exhaust W_26 H^26(M_{6,6};Q).

The equality W_26 H^26(M_{6,6};Q)=Psi_{6,6}^{26} depends on the failed primitive-quotient formula and on the missing containment of all surviving degree-at-least-7 Kunneth slots in the psi image. CKgP types the psi-generated subspace but does not compute the whole target.

The duality and twist arithmetic are correct: dimension 21 gives W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}=W_{26}H^{26}(21), and Q(-13)(21)=Q(8). The conclusion for the exact Borel-Moore group nevertheless depends on the unproved claim that the whole ordinary group is psi-generated.

finding_candidates.rationale: REV-0186 independently records the same load-bearing gap as FND-0196: fibre restriction of psi detects the slot-2 component and does not kill the slot-1 component, so the written 'psi spans i_s=2' sentence is invalid as it stands.
finding_candidates.statement: On the n-fold fibre product of the closed universal curve, the pulled-back psi class is not Kunneth-homogeneous. Fibre restriction to a fibre detects its slot-2 component but does not eliminate its slot-1 component. An argument that 'modulo i_s=0 summands, multiplication by psi_s spans the i_s=2 summands because psi_s restricts to the fibre canonical class' is therefore incomplete unless it supplies a projector, Morita vanishing of the slot-1 summand, or a downward induction on total fibre degree.

finding_candidates.rationale: REV-0186 uses the same Deligne lowest-weight fact as FND-0197 as an attack on formula (1): the open restriction supplies a surjection, not the kernel identification or traceless Schur-Weyl quotient written in ATT-0135.
finding_candidates.statement: Deligne's identification of the lowest-weight piece W_k in degree k with the image of any smooth proper compactification yields a surjection W_k H^k(C^n) ->> W_k H^k(M_{g,n}), not an identification of the kernel of restriction with the forgetful, psi, and diagonal-contraction images, and not a direct-sum decomposition of mixed Hodge structures. Leray degeneration of the smooth proper fibre power supplies an associated graded, not that written splitting. Those extra identifications are required for the primitive-quotient isomorphism and are not supplied by the surjection.

finding_candidates.rationale: This is the distinctive incomplete-rather-than-refuted attack in REV-0186. It is not a restatement of FND-0195, which records the published Canning-Larson-Payne peel, nor of FND-0196, which records the omega-class caveat without carrying the |i|>=7 bookkeeping at (6,6,26). Candidate pending independent corroboration.
finding_candidates.statement: Let C^n be the n-fold fibre product of the closed universal curve over M_g, with Leray-Kunneth summands indexed by multi-indices i in {0,1,2}^n of total fibre degree |i|. At (g,n,k)=(6,6,26), Harer vanishing H^p(M_6;L)=0 for every rational local system L and every p>19 kills every summand with |i|<=6, since those have base degree 26-|i|>=20. Every remaining summand has |i|>=7 and base degree <=19, so it is not killed by vcd(M_6). Each such summand has some slot of value 2, but that does not place the summand in the image of cup-product with a psi class: the class omega_s, and its restriction psi_s, is Kunneth-inhomogeneous, and fibre restriction does not isolate the slot-2 component. Absent a projector, Morita vanishing of the slot-1 component, or a downward induction on |i|, the surviving |i|>=7 summands form an uncontrolled complement in W_26 H^26(C^6) and therefore in its image W_26 H^26(M_{6,6};Q). CKgP at M_{6,5} types only the psi-generated subspace and does not exhaust this complement. The argument exhibits no surviving non-Tate summand, so the exact target is incomplete rather than refuted.

proof_dependency_checks.note: Poincare duality, dimension 21, degree conversion, weight conversion, and twist (21) are used correctly.

Semisimplicity in the pure weight corner justifies passing from algebraic classes or quotients of a fixed Tate type to a direct sum of that Tate structure; it cannot supply the missing exhaustion of the group.
The attempt does not infer vanishing merely from degree 26 equalling vcd(M_{6,6}); the constraint is respected.
The verified vanishing H^26(M_{6,5};Q)=0 supports only the forgetful-pullback term.
Its CKgP and tautological-Chow conclusion is correctly applied to the open moduli space M_{6,5}, not M_{6,6}.

The packet excerpt supports the Chow/CKgP material but does not license Lemma 3.1 as a black box. ATT-0135 instead claims to prove the primitive quotient formula independently, and that substitute proof fails because fibre restriction does not isolate the slot-2 Kunneth summand and the necessary projector and kernel analysis are absent.
This listed source is unused and supplies no load-bearing inference in ATT-0135.

strongest_attack: The argument never proves that it computes the whole target. Its decisive step identifies the quotient by forgetful and psi images with the all-slot-1 primitive local-system term, but the proposed fibre-restriction justification is invalid because the pulled-back psi class has slot-0, slot-1, and slot-2 Kunneth components. Virtual cohomological dimension annihilates the all-slot-1 term and, more generally, slots of total fibre degree at most 6, but it does not annihilate the total-degree-at-least-7 slots whose base degrees are at most 19. Without the missing projector or equivalent induction, those potentially non-Tate classes are neither killed nor placed in the psi image. CKgP at M_{6,5} proves only that the psi-generated subspace is Tate. Thus the submitted proof leaves an uncontrolled complement in the exact W_26 group. It does not exhibit a surviving non-Tate summand, so the theorem is incomplete rather than refuted.
theorem_statement: The exact group W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q), equivalently W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)(21), is a direct sum of Q(8); a disproof must exhibit a surviving non-Tate summand in this exact group.
